Kawhi Leonard Signs Multi-Year Extension with Toronto Raptors

The Toronto Raptors have confirmed that Kawhi Leonard has signed a multi-year contract extension with the team. This development offers the Raptors and Leonard a new opportunity, described as a "do-over," following his recent reacquisition.
